steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

notes: the oss figma alternative, self-hosted on the machine: the runner brings the official compose up at provisioning (pinned at tag 2.18.5) and docker's restart policy brings it back on every machine boot by itself - the agent never hand-rolls self-hosting. data lives in compose volumes, so pause/freeze/thaw carries the service and its data with the machine. local-first: it answers on localhost:9001; exposing it to the network is the owner's explicit choice, never a default. honest floors on the card: ~2gb ram, linux guests only
